steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What colors might be used to represent each part of the arrow?


Solution:

2 base colors should be added inside the arrow image’s outline. A lighter color (such as light purple) should be added to the top and bottom of the arrow. A darker color (such as brown) should be added to the middle part of the arrow.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What kind of color pattern might show a highlight and a shadow on the top of the arrow?


Solution:

A light color (such as white) should be added to the left side of the top of the arrow. A dark color (such as dark purple) should be added to the right side of the top of the arrow. Highlights and shadows should be added in a diagonal pattern, along the edges of the arrow’s outline.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which pixels should be updated to add depth to the arrow image?


Solution:

A dark color (such as dark purple) should be added along the middle of the arrow to soften its edges.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to modify an original pixel art image!


The arrow image should have at least 2 base colors.


A light color should be used to add a highlight and a dark color should be used to add shading to the top of the arrow.


A shadow should be used to add depth to the main part of the arrow.


Use the tools in the paint editor to update the arrow image!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original pixel art images. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Pixel Artist
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original pixel art assets to be used in a project.

badges.title: Work of Art
badges.description: Create and refine original pixel art images in the MakeCode paint editor.

badges.title: Neat n’ Tidy
badges.description: Create smooth outlines by removing jaggies in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Color Wheel
badges.description: Use analogous or complementary colors to modify the level of contrast in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Depth Perception
badges.description: Add highlights and shadows to make a pixel art image look realistic.

badges.title: I’m Dithering Away!
badges.description: Use dithering to ease the transition between colors in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Up to Scale
badges.description: Create and refine multiple sizes of a pixel art image.
